payload.title: Give Clean CLI event presentation canonical raw functional-test ownership
currentProgress: PR #1237 merged the canonical Factory Event presentation implementation and passed all applicable CI checks.
Focused CLI run, Factory Session execution, invocation, and dynamic-workflow tests pass on the accepted head.
Customer-facing output assertions still live partly in legacy built acceptance and smoke files, while the planned tests/functional/cli/factory_run/output and events packages do not yet exist.

Schema CLI resolved-input work and its generic-Cobra successor own CLI construction; Packaged Structure Sessions owns Factory Session and Wire restructuring; global config owns OpenAPI/generated config surfaces.
payload.requestedOutcome: Create the smallest behavior-preserving evidence slice that gives the merged Clean CLI event/output contract canonical raw functional-test ownership under tests/functional/cli/factory_run/output and tests/functional/cli/factory_run/events. Exercise public root.BuildProcess behavior for human, quiet, single-JSON, discriminated NDJSON, standard failure stderr, canonical event ordering, provider-chunk exclusion, and JavaScript phase/checkpoint projection using existing deterministic fixtures. Migrate or delete only directly superseded response-stream/--output assertions from legacy acceptance or smoke tests, retaining built-CLI coverage solely where actual process exit status is the behavior. Do not change production CLI behavior, command manifests or generated CLI artifacts, root/Cobra construction, Wire, OpenAPI/generated API contracts, Factory catalogs, Factory Session implementation, Makefile/test-lane topology, or unrelated tests. Prove the new packages with focused Go tests plus the narrow existing functional and built-CLI gates affected by the migration.

payload.title: Review Clean CLI event functional ownership and choose the next safe slice
payload.requestedOutcome: Inspect implementation, review, tests, changed paths, queue/session health, and Schema-Driven CLI progress after the event functional-ownership slice. Reconcile broken Work, then choose the next smallest Clean CLI slice only if its shared owners are clear.
